items.quote: This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer unto the LORD in the day when he is anointed; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual, half of it in the morning, and half thereof at night.
items.claim: Aaron and his sons shall offer a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour as a perpetual meat offering, half in the morning and half at night, in the day when he is anointed.
items.object: the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour
items.mechanism: in the day when he is anointed; half of it in the morning, and half thereof at night
